newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN 1995/6 pretax up 24 pct, div up.
newsitem.headline: EVN 1995/6 pretax up 24 pct, div up.

text.p: Austrian regional utility Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich AG (EVN) said on Tuesday pre-tax profit in 1995/6 jumped 24.4 percent to 1.484 billion schillings, clearing the way for a higher dividend.
In a statement the firm said it would pay a 25 schillings dividend for the year to August 31, up from 23 schillings.

The Lower Austrian company traced its record earnings in 1995/6 to an unusually severe winter and tight cost control. Temperatures were 11 percent below average while the workforce shrank by 3.2 percent.
"A relatively positive economic environment in Lower Austria and dynamic expansion in gas and district heating led to higher sales in all areas," EVN said.
Turnover rose 8.5 percent to 11.907 billion schillings.

District heating sales surged 43.8 percent to 423.2 GWh. Electricity sales were 5.4 up percent at 5,759 GWh and gas sales 11.1 percent up at 1.375 billion cubic metres. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
